name: Formación (Study/Training) Resident Status

requirements.blocker_text: Confirmed enrollment in higher, basic, or artistic education, a student exchange program, or an internship, at an accredited Peruvian institution.
requirements.fix_path: Obtain admission to an accredited Peruvian institution or program.

requirements.blocker_text: Lucrative work is prohibited under this status unless MIGRACIONES grants an extraordinary work permit.

evidence_required.document: Enrollment or admission confirmation from the institution or program

outcome.duration_length: up to 365 days, renewable while enrolled

sources.title: Superintendencia Nacional de Migraciones (MIGRACIONES) -- Reglamento del Decreto Legislativo N.1350, Article 29.2.c: Formación resident immigration status, up to 365 days, work prohibited without an extraordinary permit

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Peru). Formación is a RESIDENT category (unlike Turista), covering higher/basic/artistic education, exchanges, and internships in one status. citizenship_after_months (60) reflects pe_citizenship_naturalisation.json's post-Ley-32421 5-year residence figure -- see that file's notes for why it's held draft pending confirmation the new law is fully in force.
